title: Task Lifecycle Event Data
description: CloudEvent data payload for org.governancecommons.agent-matrix.task.lifecycle.v1. Emitted on task state transitions by governed agents.

task_id.description: Resource URI of the task per A2A resource_uri_scheme.

agent_id.description: agent_id of the agent that owns this task.

previous_state.description: A2A task state before this transition.

current_state.description: A2A task state after this transition.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the state transition.

trace_id.description: Governance Commons telemetry trace_id. Maps to CloudEvents traceid extension.

event_id.description: Governance Commons telemetry event_id. Combined with trace_id forms the idempotency key.

session_id.description: Optional session URI for multi-turn tasks.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for terminal state transitions (failed, canceled).

gc_error_code.description: A2A error code from error_retry_semantics when current_state is failed.
